title: Reactor with Recycle — Propane Conversion
statement:
A process is designed for a 95% overall conversion of propane. The reaction products are separated into two streams. The first stream (product) contains H2, C3H6, and 0.555% of the propane that leaves the reactor. The second stream contains the remaining unreacted propane and propylene, in an amount equal to 5% of that in the first stream, and is recycled to the reactor.

The fresh feed is 100 mol of propane.

Calculate:
1) The composition of the product stream
2) The recycle ratio (moles recycled / moles fresh feed)
3) The single-pass conversion in the reactor.

notation.description: Use the following variable definitions for all balances and calculations:

parts.prompt: Calculate the mole fraction of H2 in the product stream.
Calculate the mole fraction of C3H6 in the product stream.
Calculate the mole fraction of C3H8 in the product stream.
Calculate the recycle ratio (moles recycled / moles fresh feed).
Calculate the single-pass conversion in the reactor (in %).
